mapper.select: SELECT a.idx, (SELECT title FROM report WHERE idx = a.idx) as title FROM report a WHERE idx in ( (SELECT idx FROM report WHERE type = #{type} and idx < #{idx} and del_yn="N" ORDER BY idx DESC LIMIT 1),(SELECT idx FROM report WHERE type = #{type} and idx > #{idx} and show_yn="Y" ORDER BY idx LIMIT 1) ) and a.del_yn = 'N'
